summary: Host-local retirement-qualified learner samples conservative resource profiles and brakes pressured admission. Samples persist per execution generation and the estimator reads a bounded trailing window.

replay.detail: One immutable sample row per qualified execution generation is retained, including outside the estimator's trailing window, so replays stay deduplicated.

schema.detail: Local resource_profile_samples_v1 stores host-local sample rows. RequestClass gains recovery in wire commands and persisted execution/membership state. The general resource.admission.observed registry adds recovery and recovery-not-allowed enum values; client-v0 schema inputs and generated outputs are unchanged.

rules.detail: Samples are recorded only in the terminal receipt transaction after confirmed whole-tree retirement; rejected or truncated retirements are not admitted. Recovery admission requires signed resource_recovery_observations=1 advertisements from every active fleet incarnation, the host profile's recoveryCapable gate, and a measured filesystem free-space observation. Authority initialization and live observation writes use the same fleet gate. Withheld live evidence atomically marks durable coverage incomplete; SLO certification requires both that complete cut and a live authority. A positive advertisement alone cannot restore completeness: the next successful live membership write replays every pending observation, including retired rows, before publishing a complete cut.

compatibility.detail: Recovery is a new wire and persisted RequestClass value. Pre-reader E0 versions reject recovery during Json<Command> extraction, and one persisted recovery execution can fail their whole selected execution-list read. The minimum rollback-reader revision is E0 #6762 at b902952cfd238f9443a66f45b897bc1a40ca6a19. e8836f59 is the lossless decoding milestone; 979e9996 adds withdrawal preservation, 1a048f9e adds shell/program-child cancellation fences, and b902952c skips unsupported admission observations during authority initialization, retaining custody and marking coverage incomplete so supported work continues. Tests cover these targeted preservation and refusal guarantees, not every E1 field or a live end-to-end rollback. Main-only and E0 general registries reject replicated recovery or recovery-not-allowed enum values as invalid-replicated-claim: the envelope is degraded and those records are quarantined, but later known claims still replicate and project. They are not treated as retryable unknown fields. E1 therefore gates new recovery admission and observation writes on the signed resource_recovery_observations fleet feature, not existing health versions or recoveryCapable alone.

downtime.detail: No host deployment or caller cutover is activated by this change.

manual.detail: Deploy at least E0 b902952cfd238f9443a66f45b897bc1a40ca6a19 to hosts and clients that may read recovery state before enabling E1 writers. Upgrade every active fleet reader to E1 and obtain its signed resource_recovery_observations=1 daemon advertisement before publishing recovery admissions; the barrier refuses missing, unsigned, or false evidence. Upgrade execution hosts before routing recovery commands there and keep recoveryCapable disabled until then. Older hosts must continue receiving only previously supported classes.

recovery.detail: Retained sample rows provide permanent replay dedupe. Do not roll recovery state back to pre-reader E0 versions; the minimum rollback reader is b902952cfd238f9443a66f45b897bc1a40ca6a19. Its tested guarantees concern class strings, mixed-row readability, refusal fences, targeted cancellation and membership custody, not complete E1 metadata preservation or continued recovery semantics. Unsupported-class restart and background cleanup paths report and defer reconciliation; authority initialization skips their observations and publishes incomplete coverage instead of failing supported work. A downgraded fleet advertisement also defers E1 recovery observations. This is not a live rollback certification. Preserve original state and upgrade forward to E1 for supported reconciliation, including any invalid enum observations quarantined by an older receiver. Reclamation of samples outside the trailing window remains separate retention debt.
